Ava (PM): FYI I pushed a draft PRD for the combined API behavior (chat/completions + embeddings + rerank interplay). link: https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/rerank-integration 
Ava (PM): TL;DR — add an explicit `rerank_threshold`, clarify streaming behavior when reranking, caching rules for embeddings, and rollout/launch criteria. Need scope decision by EOD Thur.
Noah (Eng): Quick question: do we prioritise latency SLOs or rerank quality for MVP? Customers care about both but tradeoffs matter.
Maya (ML Eng): From evals: even small rerank thresholds can change top-1 a lot. We'll need evaluation harness + test prompt sets. Suggested metrics: MRR, P@1, delta against baseline, and edge-case coverage for ties / duplicate candidates.
Tom (API Eng): Proposed minimal contract for MVP (non-streaming):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "string",
  "candidates": ["string"],
  "model": "redwood-rerank-v1",
  "rerank_threshold": 0.12,  // optional, 0-1
  "stream": false
}
```
Response:
```
{
  "ordered": [ {"text": "...", "score": 0.87}, ... ],
  "applied_threshold": 0.12
}
```
Tom (API Eng): Streaming + rerank is more complex because you need to buffer tokens before final scores. Suggest MVP: no streaming with rerank; allow streaming for plain chat/completions.
Ravi (SRE): Agree with MVP constraint. Also: deployment constraints — routing fallback to smaller rerank model when GPU pool saturated. SLOs proposal: for <=5 candidates p95 latency < 200ms; for >5 allow p95 < 500ms with batching. Need cost estimate for production traffic.
Ava (PM): Draft launch criteria (proposed):
- Eval quality: MRR uplift >= 8% vs current baseline on 3 benchmark suites
- No production regressions > 2% on top-1 for core intents
- Perf: p95 latency targets met for 90% of traffic (see Ravi numbers)
- SDK + docs published and e2e examples for rerank + embeddings
- Integration tests + canary pass (see rollout plan)
Maya (ML Eng): Edge cases to call out in PRD: empty candidate list, identical candidates (dedupe rules), extremely long candidate texts, and when embedding service returns nulls. Acceptance: deterministic tie-breaker behavior + documented dedupe.
Noah (Eng): For scope negotiation with customers: propose two lanes — S1 (MVP) non-streaming rerank + embedding cache, S2 (post-launch) streaming rerank + per-token partial results. Which asks should we surface to sales?
Ava (PM): Surface S1 as GA commitment, S2 as roadmap item with timeline 'Q2 next quarter'. That keeps sales promises conservative.
Tom (API Eng): SDK changes: add `rerankThreshold` param in JS/py SDKs, update examples. Backwards compatible default = null (no rerank).
Ravi (SRE): Rollout plan: feature flag `rerank.v1.enable` -> canary 5% for 72h -> monitor latency, error-rate, quality signals -> 25% -> 100%. Auto-fallback policy: if error-rate > 1% revert.
Ava (PM): Acceptance checklist for PR: product signoff, eng signoff, perf tests, eval harness results committed to repo, docs + changelog, playbook for rollback.
Maya (ML Eng): I'll run the eval harness against the three suites once we settle the threshold default and candidate trimming policy.
Noah (Eng): Action items: 1) Tom: update API contract + SDK stub (this week) 2) Maya: run evals with threshold sweep (this week) 3) Ravi: perf/cost estimate (this week) 4) Ava: final PRD + launch plan (Mon)
Tom (API Eng): +1 on tasks. I'll open PR with API spec and example cURLs.
ci-bot: test/canary pipeline started for branch `feature/rerank-mvp` — 14 checks running :gear:
Ava (PM): Thanks all — please add any missing edge-cases in thread. We'll lock scope Friday 11am PDT. :calendar:
